accepted_recoveries: Change the hostname anti-affinity rule from required to preferred for this workload.
Use a satisfiable topology domain that preserves intended spreading when such topology is present and evidenced.
forbidden_actions: Do not delete healthy replicas to hide the unavailable replica.
Do not reduce desired replicas below the benchmark requirement.
Do not alter scheduler policy cluster-wide.
incident.injected_fault: A three-replica recommendations Deployment requires hostname-level pod anti-affinity in a two-node worker pool, leaving the final replica permanently unschedulable.
observable_signals: FailedScheduling events report that required pod anti-affinity rules cannot be satisfied.
Available nodes have adequate CPU and memory but already host matching replicas.
preconditions: Exactly two worker nodes are eligible for recommendations pods.
The Deployment requires three ready replicas for the test SLO.
Both eligible nodes have capacity for an additional replica.
required_evidence: Capture desired, ready, and unavailable replica counts.
Capture the required podAntiAffinity rule and topology key.
Capture matching pod placement across eligible nodes.
Demonstrate that resource pressure and taints are not the scheduling cause.

hypotheses.cause: The recommendations-api Deployment specifies hard pod anti-affinity (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) on topologyKey 'kubernetes.io/hostname' matching label 'app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api'. Because the cluster contains fewer eligible nodes than desired replicas (only vm-2 is available and already hosting a matching replica), the second replica is permanently unschedulable.
supports: Deployment recommendations-api spec.template.spec.affinity.podAntiAffinity has requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution for label 'app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api' on topologyKey 'kubernetes.io/hostname'.

payload.rationale: The recommendations-api Deployment specifies hard pod anti-affinity (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) matching its own label on topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname. With only one eligible node (vm-2) available in the cluster for 2 desired replicas, the second replica cannot be scheduled and remains stuck in Pending state. Changing the anti-affinity requirement to preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution allows both replicas to schedule on the single available node while maintaining topology spreading preference if additional nodes become available.
payload.rollback_trigger: The recommendations-api Deployment fails to achieve 2 ready replicas within progress deadline or the HTTP error rate exceeds 0.001 or p95 latency exceeds 200ms.

success_criteria.description: The recommendations-api Deployment reaches desired availability with 2/2 ready replicas, 0 unavailable replicas, and 5xx error rate below 0.001 with p95 latency below 200ms across consecutive test windows.
